nodes.name: go-classes-coa-test-2-import.test.ts
nodes.summary: Validates the 15-question GO Classes COA Topic Test 2 import against its official answers and topic taxonomy, including skip and correctness semantics. It also checks that the corresponding Supabase migration preserves learner answers, actual answers, and durable receipt records.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses typed JSON fixture loading and exact serialized-answer comparison to cover scalar and multiple-select responses.

nodes.name: go-classes-coa-test-2-photos.test.ts
nodes.summary: Checks that every GO Classes COA Topic Test 2 question references an answer-free practice image while both practice and attempt receipt images remain bundled on disk.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines a dynamic JSON import with filesystem existence checks for generated image assets.

nodes.name: go-classes-coa-topic-test-photos.test.ts
nodes.summary: Ensures each question in the original GO Classes COA Topic Test embeds its answer-free practice screenshot and never exposes the corresponding attempt receipt image in question HTML.
nodes.languageNotes: Resets Vitest mocks and modules before each case, then inspects dynamically imported question-bank JSON.
